items.title: Estée Lauder (EL) Stock Looks Undervalued On Cash Flow Yet Fair On Sales
items.summary: Estée Lauder Companies stock has had a difficult five year run, yet the current valuation picture is more nuanced, with the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate pointing to meaningful upside while market based multiples look closer to fair. The share price is down 67.7% over five years, which means any recovery case now leans heavily on how much earnings and cash flows can rebuild from here. Recent progress in revenue growth and margins may support the DCF based upside case...

items.title: Estee Lauder vs Nike: One Turnaround Just Proved Itself, the Other Keeps Slipping
